notes.database: Postgres 16 runs as the `db` compose service; credentials are local-only and generated in compose.
notes.auth: Session cookies (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax) are stored server-side in the Session table; no external auth provider or signing secret is required to boot.
notes.seedAccounts: admin@zarrin.ir / Zarrin@1404 (ADMIN) and customer@zarrin.ir / Zarrin@1404 (CUSTOMER). Override with SEED_ADMIN_PASSWORD.
notes.paymentGateway: Configured in the admin dashboard (Settings). Default is manual; no credentials required to boot.
